title: WoT Blitz Memory Offset Table
description: Discovered memory offsets for reading replay state from the game process.

executableSha256.description: SHA-256 of wotblitz.exe, for exact binary matching.

discoveredAtUtc.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when offsets were last updated; null for an unpopulated placeholder.

replayTime.description: Base-relative offset for replay timeline (double, seconds). 0 = unknown.

playerHP.description: Base-relative offset for player HP (int32). 0 = unknown.

playerPositionX.description: Chained field: see `chains`. The integer stays 0 (the position is reached through the module-relative chain, not a direct base-relative offset). float X at record +0x10.

playerPositionY.description: Chained field: see `chains`. The integer stays 0 (the position is reached through the module-relative chain, not a direct base-relative offset). float Y at record +0x14.

playerPositionZ.description: Chained field: see `chains`. The integer stays 0 (the position is reached through the module-relative chain, not a direct base-relative offset). float Z at record +0x18.

playerYaw.description: Base-relative offset for player yaw (float, radians). 0 = unknown.

cameraPitch.description: Base-relative offset for camera pitch (float, radians). 0 = unknown.

aliveTankCount.description: Base-relative offset for alive tank count (int32). 0 = unknown.

chains.description: Module-relative pointer chain for chained fields (position family). offsets.<field> stays 0 for chained fields by design: the runtime observation path computes moduleBase + offset, which cannot represent a chain, and the ring record itself is battle-scoped heap. The resolver reads chained fields via its own hash-bound layout. Hops: rootRva first, recordOffset last, memberOffset/ringIndex in between. ringIndex requires indexOffset (Int32 current-index field offset) and stride (ring entry stride). The 11.19.0.10 position chains document the resolver's traversal but are NOT mechanically walkable end-to-end (cached fast path + alternative tree roots are branches, not sequential derefs; the ring step needs ringIndex).

indexOffset.description: Required for ringIndex: Int32 current-index field offset in the object holding the ring pointer.

stride.description: Required for ringIndex: ring entry stride.

fieldValidation.description: Per-field promotion status and provenance evidence.

confidence.description: How confident we are in these offsets.

notes.description: Free-form notes about discovery process, quirks, or caveats.
